name: senderscope
description: Reverse email lookup, email finder and email verifier for B2B: MCP connector for Senderscope. See who owns a work email, find a work email and verify addresses.
long_description: Reverse email lookup, email finder and email verifier for B2B in your AI assistant. Ask who owns this email and get the professional profile behind a work address: name, title, company and LinkedIn. Find a work email from a name and company domain or a LinkedIn profile, and run email verification on any address. Lookups use your Senderscope credits, one per result found. get_account reads your plan and credits. lookup_email returns the professional profile and deliverability behind a work email; find_email finds a work email from a name and company domain or a LinkedIn URL; verify_email checks deliverability, accept-all, SPF and DMARC. Each uses one credit only when it returns a result. list_lookups and get_lookup read your history for free.
